instantiated_cells.justification: The lobbyist definition covers any individual employed by a principal or who "contracts for or receives economic consideration, other than reimbursement for actual expenses" — no dollar threshold is set.

The lobbyist definition in §13.62(11) is based on receipt of economic consideration and days of communication, with no expenditure-based trigger for the lobbyist's own registration anywhere in §§13.62–13.64.

A principal must list a lobbyist's name, address, and total amount only "if the total amount of lobbying expenditures and obligations … made or incurred to any lobbyist for the principal exceeds $200 during the reporting period" — establishing a $200 per-lobbyist itemization threshold.

A principal anticipating aggregate lobbying expenditures/obligations "not exceeding $500 in a calendar year" may file a verified statement and is then exempt from registration under §13.64, licensing under §13.63, and reporting under §13.68; §13.64(1) likewise triggers registration only when expenditures exceed $500.

Wisconsin uses a 5-day-of-communication test (§13.62(11)) and a 10-hour reporting carve-out for non-lobbyist employees (§13.68(1)(a)), but no statute defines a percent-of-compensated-time threshold that exempts a lobbyist from filing.

content.text:
I'll analyze each row against the Wisconsin statute text.

**Row 001 (compensation threshold for lobbyist definition):** §13.62(11) defines a lobbyist as someone "employed by a principal, or contracts for or receives economic consideration, other than reimbursement for actual expenses" — no dollar threshold.

**Row 002 (lobbyist-side expenditure threshold):** The statute has no lobbyist-side expenditure trigger; thresholds in §13.64(1) and §13.621(5) are principal-side.

**Row 003 (time standard in lobbyist definition):** §13.62(11) says if duties are not exclusively lobbying, the individual is a lobbyist only if making lobbying communications "on each of at least 5 days within a reporting period."

**Row 004 (per-item itemization threshold):** §13.68(1)(a)6 requires listing a lobbyist's name/address only if expenditures to that lobbyist exceed $200 in the reporting period. This is the closest itemization threshold.

**Row 005 (de minimis filing exemption):** §13.621(5) and §13.64(1) — principals under $500/year aggregate are exempt from registration/reporting (may file verified statement instead).

**Row 006 (time-percent filing exemption):** §13.68(1)(a) excludes from reported lobbying expenditures employees who "devote not more than 10 hours to lobbying during a reporting period" — but this is an hours threshold, not a percent of compensated time. No percent-of-time exemption exists.
